rationale: Zelenskyy-Trump UN meeting remains top priority for aid; Congress passes Russia sanctions bill marking first Ukraine-support legislation in two years—significant diplomatic development for war effort.

top_events.title: Congress passes sweeping US sanctions bill targeting Russia
top_events.label: US Congress passes Russia sanctions bill
top_events.summary: First Ukraine-support legislation in over two years from US Congress. Strengthens Western pressure on Russia, directly supporting Ukraine's war effort and diplomatic position.

top_events.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
top_events.label: Iranian strikes damage US bases confirmed
top_events.summary: Images confirm extensive damage at US military sites from Iranian attacks. Diverts US military focus and resources away from Ukraine support during critical war phase.

top_events.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
top_events.label: Gaza building collapse kills 21 people
top_events.summary: War-damaged building in Gaza City collapses, killing 21 including eight children. Distant humanitarian tragedy with no direct impact on Ukraine's war situation.
